extraction.name: MINT-1T
extraction.description: A multimodal interleaved dataset with one trillion text tokens and 3.4 billion images, built from HTML, PDF, and ArXiv documents for pre-training large multimodal models.
extraction.creator: Anas Awadalla, Le Xue, Oscar Lo, Manli Shu, Hannah Lee, Etash Guha, Matt Jordan, Sheng Shen, Mohamed Awadalla, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu, Yejin Choi, Ludwig Schmidt
extraction.publisher: University of Washington, Salesforce Research, Stanford University, University of Texas at Austin, University of California Berkeley
extraction.citeAs: MINT-1T: Scaling Open-Source Multimodal Data by 10x: A Multimodal Dataset with One Trillion Tokens
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected from CommonCrawl WARC and WAT dumps and from ArXiv S3 buckets. HTML documents were parsed from CommonCrawl WARC files, PDF documents were sourced from CommonCrawl WAT files, and ArXiv documents were built from LaTeX source code. The collection pipeline included filtering, deduplication, image downloading, NSFW detection, and PII masking.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Software Collection, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: None explicitly reported for individual instances.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: CommonCrawl WARC files for HTML documents, CommonCrawl WAT files for PDF documents, and ArXiv S3 buckets / LaTeX source code for ArXiv documents.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: January 2024 to June 2024; web data spans 2013 to 2024, with HTML documents from May 2017 to April 2024 and PDF documents from February 2023 to April 2024.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Documents were filtered for text quality, non-English content, NSFW substrings, duplicate n-grams, low-quality content, and undesirable images. Email addresses were anonymized and IP addresses replaced with randomly generated non-functional IPs. Paragraph/document deduplication and image deduplication were applied. PDFs were parsed to extract reading order and images; ArXiv LaTeX was cleaned by removing imports, bibliography, tables, and citation tags.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Low-quality text, duplicate documents/text portions, non-English documents, non-retrievable image links, images smaller than 150 pixels, images larger than 20,000 pixels, and documents containing NSFW images were removed. HTML documents with no images or more than thirty images were filtered out. PDFs over 50MB or over 50 pages were discarded, and pages with no text were excluded.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: FastText language identification, PyMuPDF/PyMuPDF2 for PDF parsing, TexSoup for ArXiv parsing, NSFW image detector (GantLaborde/nsfw_model), Bloom Filter-based deduplication (bff), and text quality filters from datatrove/RefinedWeb-style rules.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors will actively respond to issues and maintain the dataset. Updates will be communicated through the Hugging Face README, errata will be posted there, older versions will remain accessible via Git history, and contributions can be submitted through Hugging Face pull requests.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Email addresses and IP addresses were explicitly masked. The paper notes that the dataset may contain personally identifiable information, sensitive content, and potentially information about age, gender, geography, language, culture, experience, race or ethnic origins, sexual orientation, religious beliefs, political opinions, union membership, locations, financial or health data, biometric or genetic data, government identification, or criminal history if present on the public web.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to make research into large multimodal models more accessible and to support open science. The authors note potential harmful content from the web and emphasize filtering of personally identifiable information and not-safe-for-work content.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The authors state they avoid using text quality classifier models because such models have been shown to favor text from certain demographics. They also note that previous datasets were biased toward Humanities and Social Sciences, while MINT-1T aims for broader domain coverage.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is not self-contained and relies on external image URLs that may disappear over time. The full dataset is too large to host with images included. PDF parsing can miss images and produce incorrect reading order. The authors caution that future work should improve safety filtering and data quality. They also state the dataset should not be used for training models that ingest or generate personally identifying information or for military applications.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Pre-training large multimodal models that process interleaved images and text; training large multimodal models; generating interleaved image-text sequences; building multimodal document retrieval systems. The dataset has only a training split.
